name: io.github.MakersMCP/makersmcp
title: MakersMCP
description: Free kits for makers: brand kits, fonts, screenshots, films, music, captions and video formats.

environmentVariables.name: MAKERSMCP_OUT
environmentVariables.description: Where the kits save their folders; ~ is your home folder. Leave it out for the folder makersmcp starts in, or ~/makersmcp when it cannot write there.

environmentVariables.name: MAKERSMCP_KITS
environmentVariables.description: The kits to turn on, with commas between them, like easybrandkit,launch-film. Leave it out, or give all, for every kit.

environmentVariables.name: MAKERSMCP_KIT_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: A kit's checkout to run instead of the package that comes with makersmcp, as kit=folder, with commas between several.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave the kits use, by its path or a command name on PATH, when makersmcp does not find one.

environmentVariables.name: FFMPEG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The ffmpeg the video and music kits use, by its path or a command name on PATH, when makersmcp does not find one.

environmentVariables.name: FFPROBE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The ffprobe the film, reframe and caption kits read videos with, by its path or a command name on PATH, when makersmcp finds none beside ffmpeg.
